rules.accepted_credit_types: Automatically approved: courses planned, sponsored or cosponsored by accredited universities/colleges, medical schools, state or national medical/osteopathic associations, national medical specialty societies, APTA or other national/state PT associations, and FSBPT-approved courses; other activities can be Board-approved. 1 hour = 60 minutes. Scholarship (peer-reviewed publications, posters) up to 9 h; education/teaching up to 9 h; coursework (academic PT courses, APTA residency/fellowship, ABPTS certification, PTA advanced proficiency, approved workshops/seminars/conferences) up to 18 h; FSBPT or APTA self-assessment tools up to 3 h. Not credited: individual self-directed study programs, employment orientation, entertainment, holding office, management seminars not directly concerning PT operations.
rules.new_licensee_rule: The first two-year CE cycle begins January 1 after initial licensure; courses taken between licensure and that January 1 may count toward the first cycle.
rules.audit_note: Attest at the renewal after each 2-year CE cycle; the Board periodically samples licensees and may request evidence for up to two consecutive compliance periods.

topics.who: All PTs and PTAs: professional ethics directly related to the practice of physical therapy; counts toward the 20 hours

rules.notes: Licenses renew annually before January 1 (Minn. Stat. §148.73); the CE requirement runs on a separate two-year cycle and is attested at the renewal following the end of each cycle. PTA requirements are the same as for PTs. Board website (mn.gov) blocked our automated check with a bot challenge; figures taken from Minnesota Rules.
rules.rule_quote: Every two years, each physical therapist and physical therapist assistant licensed by the board shall obtain 20 contact hours of continuing education credit as required by parts 5601.2200 to 5601.2600.
